claims.name: Wire16Proofs.complete_iff
claims.statement:
∀ (header : Header) (available consumed : UInt32),
  Wire16.classify header available = Availability.complete consumed ↔
    header.length.toNat ≤ available.toNat ∧ consumed.toNat = header.length.toNat

claims.name: Wire16Proofs.encode_parse_roundtrip
claims.statement:
∀ (q : ByteQuad),
  q.b0 = 1 → q.b1.toNat < 4 → ∃ h, Wire16.parse q = ParseResult.parsed h ∧ Wire16.encode h = EncodeResult.encoded q

claims.name: Wire16Proofs.encode_success_iff
claims.statement:
∀ (h : Header) (q : ByteQuad),
  Wire16.encode h = EncodeResult.encoded q ↔
    h.flags.toNat < 4 ∧
      q.b0 = 1 ∧ q.b1 = h.flags ∧ q.b2.toNat = h.length.toNat / 256 ∧ q.b3.toNat = h.length.toNat % 256

claims.name: Wire16Proofs.need_more_iff
claims.statement:
∀ (header : Header) (available missing : UInt32),
  Wire16.classify header available = Availability.needMore missing ↔
    available.toNat < header.length.toNat ∧ missing.toNat = header.length.toNat - available.toNat

claims.name: Wire16Proofs.parse_encode_roundtrip
claims.statement:
∀ (h : Header),
  h.flags.toNat < 4 → ∃ q, Wire16.encode h = EncodeResult.encoded q ∧ Wire16.parse q = ParseResult.parsed h

claims.name: Wire16Proofs.parse_reserved_flags_iff
claims.statement: ∀ (q : ByteQuad), Wire16.parse q = ParseResult.reservedFlags ↔ q.b0 = 1 ∧ 4 ≤ q.b1.toNat

claims.name: Wire16Proofs.parse_success_iff
claims.statement:
∀ (q : ByteQuad) (h : Header),
  Wire16.parse q = ParseResult.parsed h ↔
    q.b0 = 1 ∧ q.b1.toNat < 4 ∧ h.flags = q.b1 ∧ h.length.toNat = q.b2.toNat * 256 + q.b3.toNat
